scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium

rules: No Inter, Roboto, or generic default sans-serifs.
Headlines must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter).
Use Playfair Display for small editorial moments (like testimonial quotes or manifesto chapter numbers) to add a premium touch.
Ensure hierarchy gap rule: jumping from H1 to H3 or body text must feel intentional and grounded.
Use colors strictly as accents on the warm neutral canvas to maintain a premium, airy feel.
Never use pure black or pure white; always tint with the canvas tone.
Avoid large blocks of solid brand colors; use them for borders, badges, buttons, and hover states.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a very subtle SVG noise overlay (opacity-20) to the main canvas to reduce digital sterility and enhance the editorial feel.

sections.hero: Min-height 90vh, flex flex-col justify-center relative. Center-aligned text for 'Complete Care Under One Family', bottom-aligned interactive picker.
sections.brand_cards: CSS Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8. High density but lots of internal card padding (p-8 to p-10).
sections.manifesto: Bento or asymmetric masonry layout mapping out numbered chapters.
sections.testimonials: Centered, max-w-4xl mx-auto, rotating with a distinctive thick left-border utilizing the specific brand's color.

hero_picker.style: Flex row, gap-4, pill-shaped buttons (rounded-full). Default state: canvas tone + subtle border. Hover state: slight scale-up, bg shifts to respective brand surface color.
hero_picker.interaction: Clicking smooth-scrolls to the brand cards section and briefly highlights the corresponding card (via a subtle ring or shadow pulse).

brand_cards.structure: Image area at top (aspect-video, clipped frame, grayscale to color on hover), Logo, One-liner, Max 2 badges, Hours, Address, 2 Buttons (Primary action + Call).
brand_cards.expander: An accordion or 'More info' chip that expands the card height to reveal service chips, extra details, and a website link. Must animate smoothly.
brand_cards.styling: White background, soft-radius (rounded-2xl), subtle shadow. Brand color applied ONLY as subtle accents (e.g., button bg, badge text/bg, hover ring).

badges.style: Inline-flex, items-center, rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider. Bg is 10% opacity of brand color, Text is 100% brand color.

gradient_divider.style: h-[2px] w-full bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D31245] via-[#1FA48A] to-[#9BB8A5]. Used selectively to separate major sections (e.g., above footer).

floating_pill.style: Fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50, dark navy bg, white text, pill shape, subtle bounce animation on load. Opens a slide-over form.
floating_pill.slide_over: Right-aligned drawer, backdrop-blur-md, clean form layout with a customized Shadcn Select dropdown to choose the brand.

sticky_mobile_bar.style: Fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full z-40 flex justify-between bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-black/5 p-4 md:hidden.

marquee.style: Slow-moving, extremely large outline text (text-8xl or 9xl), font-serif (Playfair), low opacity (text-black/5), used as a background texture.

motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for the H1. Use Framer Motion to animate `y` from 100% to 0% with `overflow: hidden` on the parent container. Stagger children.
motion.scroll_reveal: Use Framer Motion `whileInView` for sections. Fade up and slight y-translation (y: 40 -> 0) with a spring transition (damping: 20, stiffness: 100).
motion.parallax: Use Framer Motion `useScroll` and `useTransform` to slightly move background abstract shapes or the hero image slower than the foreground text.
motion.interactions: All buttons must have a `whileHover={{ scale: 1.02 }}` and `whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}`. Expandable cards must use Framer Motion `AnimatePresence` and `layout` for smooth height transitions.
motion.lenis: Implement Lenis at the root of the app for smooth, premium momentum scrolling. This is mandatory for the Awwwards feel.

admin_panel.layout: Sidebar navigation (w-64) + Main content area. Background: #F8FAFC. Cards: #FFFFFF.
admin_panel.typography: Inter or Satoshi for optimal data legibility. Dense, clear hierarchy.

components.tables: Shadcn UI Tables. Clean lines, sticky header, hover rows.
components.forms: Shadcn UI Forms. Distinct focus states (ring-2 ring-navy-500). Group fields logically (e.g., Brand Info, Services, Hours).
components.dashboard: High-level stats at the top (Messages read/unread), Quick links to edit specific brands.

features: Content Editor for Hero, About, Testimonials
Brand Editor (Dynamic form for 3 brands: fields for logo, colors, services chips, hours, address)

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA standards. Navy text on warm canvas exceeds 7:1.
accessibility.motion: Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`. Disable parallax and complex reveals if true.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (e.g., `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-navy-800`).
accessibility.aria: Use ARIA expanded for accordion cards, and appropriate roles for the floating form drawer.

hero_background.description: Abstract warm neutral gradient for the hero background parallax effect.

brand_pharmasave.description: Clean, modern pharmacy bottles on a shelf, used as a subtle placeholder for Pharmasave card.

brand_crescent.description: Contemporary, bright clinic reception for Crescent Medical Centre.

brand_physio.description: Modern physiotherapy studio showing action/care for The Physio Studio.

testimonial_portrait.description: Diverse happy patients portrait for the testimonials section.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a hybrid_fullstack app. The frontend includes a high-end marketing single-page site AND an Admin CMS dashboard.
Use Framer Motion for all animations. Implement the masked line-by-line reveal on the H1 exactly as described.
Integrate Lenis for smooth scrolling at the top level of the public app.
For the 'What do you need today?' picker, clicking a button should trigger a smooth scroll to the brand cards section and visually highlight the correct card.
The 3 brand cards MUST have an expandable 'More info' section that uses Framer Motion's AnimatePresence for a seamless height transition.
The admin panel should be routed separately (e.g., `/admin`) and use a standard, dense Shadcn UI layout. Do not apply the marketing site's heavy animations to the admin panel.

DO NOT use raw tags without alt attributes. Use semantic HTML5 structural tags (
,
,
).
All interactive elements (buttons, form inputs, expanders) MUST have a `data-testid` attribute in kebab-case.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Prioritize the bold art direction requested.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Never apply `transition: all`. Specify exact properties (e.g., `transition-colors duration-300`).
Never center align the entire app container (`text-align: center`). Keep natural left-aligned reading flows except for specific centered hero/testimonial elements.
Avoid AI assistant emojis. Use professional SVGs (Lucide, Phosphor).
Use `sonner` for all toast notifications in both public site and admin panel.
Ensure the gradient divider (red -> teal -> sage) is used tastefully as a thematic unifier, not an overpowering background.
